verbetes.glosa_atual: (גזז) cortado, de onde; filial, clube.; pedaço.
notas_originais: Snh. 7 a אדייה לגְּזִיזֵיה וכ' lifted up his club and stood (against me; Rashi: his fist). B. Kam. 5 a תבריה ר"ע לגזיזיה R. Akiba has broken the force of his club (Rashi: fist), i.e. modified his opinion; ib. 42 b

ג' דברדא a piece of ice. Targ. I Chr. XI, 22 תבר ג' דב' וכ' he cut a hole in the ice and bathed; Ber. 18 b גְּזִיזֵי.— Pl. גְּזִיזֵי. Ib. 59 a גְּזִיזַיָּיה דברדא Ar. (ed. גזיזי דברזא) hail-stones (Ms. M. בְּזִיזַיָּה דנורא or בְּזָאַיָּה, Ms. F. גְּזִירֵי, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note).

verbetes.glosa_atual: (גזז); tosquia de lã.; (= חתיכה, v. precedido.) pedaço, fragmento.
notas_originais: Yalk. Num. 750 (Korah, beg.) זמן הג' (Midr. Till. to Ps. I זמן גיזה) the season of shearing. Ḥull. 135 a מחוסר ג' וכ' wants shearing, redemption &c. Gen. R. s. 74; s. 85; Midr. Sam. ch. XXIII כל מקום שנ' ג' וכ' wherever shearing is mentioned in biblical accounts, it marks (an important epoch).
— Pl. גְּזִיזוֹת. Y. Orl. III, 63 a top (in Chald. diction) what profit is it to him גזים גזיזית (read … זוֹת) to cut it into shreds?

definicoes_originais: (גזי) cuts (of the road), paths, narrow passages.
notas_originais: Pes. 19 b (Ms. M. גויי', clerical error). Ib. 113 a top.
, v. גָּזֵל

Targ. Lev. V, 21 (Y. גְּזוֹלָא); a. e.— Pl. גְּזֵילַיָּיא. Y. B. Kam. X, beg. 7 b אזל תניה לג' the Tannai (Tosef. B. Mets. V, 26) goes over (from usurers’ gains) to robbed objects.— Pl. f. גְּזֵילָתָא, גְּזֵלָ'. Targ. Koh. V, 7.

B. Kam. 98 b משלם כשעת הג' he must make retribution according to the value of the object at the time it was robbed. Y. ib. X, 7 b bot. ג' מפורסמת a well-known robbery or robbed object. Treat. S’maḥ. ch. IX מרובה גְזֵילַת המת וכ' severer is the crime of robbery (or wrong) committed against a dead person &c.— Pl. גְּזֵילוֹת, גְּזֵלוֹת. Snh. I, 1 ג' וחבלות law-suits of larceny and mayhem. Gitt. 55 b that it may not be said מזבח אוכל ג' the altar receives illegitimately acquired goods; Y. ib. V, 47 b top.—Keth. 105 a; ib. XIII, 1 דייני ג' Y. ed. (Bab. גזירות) judges in suits of robbery; Bab. ib. 105 a (harmonizing the two versions) גוזרי גזירות על ג' decreeing fines in cases of robbery. [Targ. Cant. VI, 6 גְּזֵלָה a. גְּזֵילֹות h. forms.]
, v. גְּזַם
Targ. Gen. XLVII, 26 (ed. Berl. גְּזֵירָה, h. text חֹק). Pl. גְּזֵירִין. Targ. Esth. I, 19 archive of decrees.—גְּזֵירַן. Targ. Ezek. XX, 25. V. גְּזֵירְתָא.
, v. preced. a. גְּזֵרָה.
, Lam. R. to IV, 7, v. גִּיזְרָה.—Y. Keth. V, 30 a חכים לג', v. גָּזוֹרָא.

hazâr paiti; v. Perl. Et. St. p. 118, a. authorities quot. ib.) name of a class of oppressive Persian officers (chiliarchi). Taan. 20 a. Snh. 98 a; Sabb. 139 a. [Ar. גאזי דפטי, גזי דפ'; Var. גזיר פ', גזיר דפ', גרז דיפטי, גיזרפטי, גוזרפ' &c., v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. c.]

verbetes.glosa_atual: (גזר); circuncisão, prepúcio, v. גְּזוּרְתָּא.; (= h. גְּזֵרָה) decreto, édito, portaria.
notas_originais: Targ. Y. II Ex. IV, 25 sq. (some ed. גְּזֵירָ').

Targ. Ex. V, 14 גְּזֵירַתְכוֹן your decreed task. Targ. I Kings X, 25 גְּזֵירַת וכ' the decreed (tax) of every year. Targ. O. Ex. I, 8; a. fr.—Gitt. 55 b ג' קמייתא the first (Roman) decree (after the capture of Jerusalem). Ab. Zar. 35 a כי גזרי ג' וכ' when they published a (religious) enactment in Palestine.— Pl. גְּזֵירָתָא. Targ. Job XIV, 5.

verbetes.glosa_atual: pedra talhada; parede de pedras quadradas.
definicoes_originais: hewn stone; wall of squared stones.
notas_originais: B. Bath. I, 1, contrad. to גְּוִיל. B. Mets. 117 b; a. fr.—לשכת הג' the cell of Gazith, name of a Temple compartment, the seat of the Great Sanedrin. Midd. V, 4; a. fr.—Trnsf. אבן ג' ( squared stone), a plain interpreter of Bible texts ( Midrash). Ab. d’R. N. ch. XXVIII; 2 d vers. ch. XLVI.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (b. h.) arrancar, roubar (com acusação de pessoa ou de objeto); tomar ilegitimamente.; ser roubado (de objeto levado ou de pessoa privada).
definicoes_originais: (b. h.) to tear away, rob (with accus. of person or of object); to take illegitimately.
to be robbed (of object taken, or of person deprived).
notas_originais: B. Kam. X, 5 הגּוֹזֵל שדה מ־ he who robs a field from his neighbor (takes forcible possession). Ib. 6 הגוזל את וכ' he who robs his neighbor (takes illegitimately what belongs to his neighbor). Ib. 7 גְּזַלְתִּיךָ I have wronged thee (and owe thee retribution). Ber. 35 b כאילו גוֹזֵל להקב"ה as though he robbed the Lord. Taan. 16 a ג' מריש ובנאו בבירה if one robbed a beam and placed it in a large building; a. v. fr.— Part. גּוֹזֵל robber, pl. גּוֹזְלִין. Y. B. Bath. III, 14 a bot. האומנין והג' וכ' mechanics (who take working material to their homes) and robbers cannot claim the right of possession, v. חֲזָקָה.— Part. pass. גָּזוּל robbed, illegitimately acquired. Succ. III, 1; a. fr.

B. Kam. 95 a, a. e. קרקע אינה נִגְזֶלֶת landed property cannot be robbed, i.e. can never become legitimate property by the law of limitation, v. יִאוּשׁ.—Part. נִגְזָל the person robbed of his property, claimant. Shebu. VII, 1; a. fr.
Targ. Lev. V, 23; a. e.—B. Kam. 103 a מִיגְזַל גַזְלוּהָ they acquired it illegitimately. Ib. 96 a; a. fr.—[גזל to spin, Targ. Y. Ex. XXXV, 26, quoted in Ar. s. v. כש 3, read עזל.]

Sabb. 32 b בעוון ג' וכ' as a punishment for the crime of oppression, the locust rises &c. (ref. to Am. IV, 1 a. 9). Gen. R. s. 31, beg. שׁטופים בזימה ובג' steeped in lust and violence. Pes. 113 b Canaan bequeathed to his sons … אהבו את הג' love ye violence. B. Kam. 80 b אין בו משום ג' the law of robbery does not apply to it (it is not private property). Erub. 100 b we should have learned ג' מנמלה the regard of property from the ant. B. Kam. 109 a עד שיוציא גְּזֵילוֹ וכ' until he dispossesses himself of his robbery. Ib. שיוציא גזילה (corr. acc.). Ib. b גזילו יוצא וכ' his robbery must go out of his possession. Y. B. Mets. II, 8 c גזילו של גוי וכ' what has been illegitimately taken from a gentile, is forbidden (must be restored). Y. Gitt. IV, 45 c מפני ג' השבט in order to protect the (priestly) tribe from loss; Y. Orl. II, 61 d bot. מפני גיל השבט (corr. acc.); a. fr.
, v. גזיל'
, Y. B. Mets. I, 8 a bot. ג' הדיינין, v. גּוֹזָל

B. Kam. 62 a (defin.) חמסן … ג' לא יהיב וכ' ḥ amsan (violent man) is one who (takes by force and) pays; gazlan—who takes without paying. Snh. 26 b ג' דאורייתא a robber in the strict (Biblical) sense; ג' דרבנן a robber in a wider (Rabbinical) sense, e.g. a gambler &c.; ib. 25 b.—Y. Snh. VIII, 26 b he who takes an object in the presence of witnesses is called thief (גַּנָּב), he who takes in the owner’s presence—ג' a robber; v. B. Kam. 79 b. Y. Kidd. II, 62 b bot. כל המשנה וכ' he who changes the use of a loaned object without the owner’s consent נקרא גו' is called a robber. Ib. I, 60 c top גו'; a. fr.— Pl. גַּזְלָנִים, גַּזְלָנִין, גּוֹזְלָ'. Snh. l. c. Ib. 38 a; a. fr.

verbetes.glosa_atual: B. Banho. 30b; um. e.- Pl. גַּזְלָנִין, גַּזְלָנֵי. Snh. 26b. B. Kam. 79b
notas_originais: B. Bath. 30 b; a. e.— Pl. גַּזְלָנִין, גַּזְלָנֵי. Snh. 26 b. B. Kam. 79 b
B. Bath. 47 a הוחזק על שדה זו בג' (not החזיק, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) he is known as possessing this field through illegitimate means.

verbetes.glosa_atual: Snh. 23 b ערער דג' uma objeção levantada contra a aptidão das testemunhas por causa de seu comércio ilegítimo. Ib. 27 a פסלינהו בג' eles os desqualificaram, denunciando-os por roubo.
notas_originais: Snh. 23 b ערער דג' an objection raised against the fitness of witnesses on account of their illegitimate trade. Ib. 27 a פסלינהו בג' they disqualified them by denouncing them for robbery.
, v. גְּזֵילָא

verbetes.glosa_atual: (v. גזז) cortar, aparar.; cortar galhos (para deixar escorrer a seiva), bater.; Transf. (cmp. b. h. קרץ a. Targ. Prov. XVI, 30) para ameaçar travessuras.
definicoes_originais: to cut branches off (for letting the sap drip), to tap.
Trnsf. (cmp. b. h. קרץ a. Targ. Prov. XVI, 30) to threaten mischief.
notas_originais: Ab. Zar. 50 b אין מְגַזְּמִין you must not tap (in the festive week or in the Sabbath year).
Num. R. s. 14 שהיא מְגַזֶּמֶת לעשות לו which she was threatening to do unto him.
Y. Orl. III, 63 a top גָּזֵים וכ', v. גְּזִיזָה.

Targ. Prov. XVI, 30 (h. text קרץ). Shebu. 46 a עביד איניש דגזים וכ' a man frequently threatens mischief and does not do it. Ib. הכי נמי ג' וכ' (not דג', v. Rabb. D. S. a. l.) in this case, too, he may have threatened and not done it.
B. Mets. 104 b, v. גּוּזְמָא.

definicoes_originais: (cmp. גָּדַע) to cut off, lop off.
notas_originais: [Gen. R. s. 12 גזעה קומתו, read גָּוְעָה, v. גָּוע.]

verbetes.glosa_atual: precedido.) tronco, caule, toco; aquilo que cresce no tronco, atire.
definicoes_originais: preced.) trunk, stem, stump; that which grows out of the trunk, shoot.
notas_originais: B. Bath. V, 4 העולה מן הג' whatever shoots out of the trunk, opp. שרשים; defined ib. 82 a כל שרואה … מן הג' whatever sees (when shooting) the light of day is ‘from the geza’ (and belongs to the owner of the tree). Ib. דקל אין לו ג' a date tree has no geza, i.e. the purchaser of a date tree has no claim on shoots growing out of the trunk; ib. אין לו ג' לבעל הדקל לפי שאין לו ג' Ms. M. (ed. שאין מוציא ג', v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) the owner … has no claim &c., because the stump of a date-tree has no shoots. Ib. 80 b אין גִּזְעָן מחליף their stump grows no new shoots. Nidd. 55 a שער … גִּזְעוֹ מחליף hair, if cut, grows again. Ib. בשר ג' מחליף flesh, if cut, regenerates; a. fr.—Trnsf. (of persons) ג' ישישים a shoot, offspring of worthy men M. Kat. 25 b

—Ithpe. אִיגְּזַף wrath is enkindled. Ab. Zar. 55 a דכי מִגְּזַף בעלמא ולא אתי מטרא וכ' Ar. where, when the world is cursed, and no rain comes, he (the idol) appears to them in a dream &c.; [Ms. M. מנדיף, Ag. Hatt. מינזף עלמא, v. נְזַף; En Yakob מנגיב עלמא, v. נְגַב; ed. דכי מצטריך עלמ' למיטרא].

verbetes.glosa_atual: v. cmp. גדר); cortar; גּוֹזֵר.; cortar, guardar; גִּיזְרָה a. גְּזֵרָה;—trnsf.; ser decretado, ordenado.
definicoes_originais: to cut off, to guard ; v. גִּיזְרָה a. גְּזֵרָה;—trnsf.
to be cut off, be steep.
notas_originais: to institute a precautionary measure (גְּזֵרָה); to enact a prohibition, to decree (mostly in a restrictive sense). Sabb. I, 4 ושמנה … גָּזְרוּ בו ביום they issued eighteen enactments on that day. Ib. 14 b ג' טומאה על וכ' declared metal vessels (of gentiles) unclean (even when broken and remolten, v. ib. 16 b). Ib. 17 b גזרו על פתן משום וכ' they prohibited their (the gentiles’) bread in order to prevent the use of their oil &c. Ib. 30 a מלך בו"ד גּוֹזֵר גזירה a mortal king issues a decree. Ber. 61 b גָּזְרָה מלכות הרשעה שמד על ישראל שלא וכ' Ms. M. (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) the wicked (Roman) government decreed religious persecution over Israel, that they should not study the Law &c. R. Hash. 18 b גזרו תענית they ordered a public fast. Ib. II, 9 גּוֹזְרַנִי עליך וכ' I order thee to come to me &c. Yoma 67 b (ref. to גזרה, Lev. XVI, 22) אני ה' גְּזַרְתִּיו וכ' I, the Lord, have ordained it; a. v. fr.
R. Hash. 17 b נִגְזְרָה גזירה it has been decreed. Ber. 58 b; a. fr.
Yoma l. c. (ref. to גזרה, Lev. l. c.) דבר המִתְגַּזֵּר where an object thrown down is shattered to pieces. [
Ib. Ms. 2 מקום המתג' a steep place.]

verbetes.glosa_atual: ,; cortar, dividir.; circuncidar, circuncidar-se.; decretar; decretar uma proibição como medida de precaução, proibir, proteger.
definicoes_originais: to circumcise, have one’s self circumcised.
to decree; to enact a prohibition as a precautionary measure, to prohibit, guard.
notas_originais: Targ. Ps. LXXIV, 13 (h. text פרר). Targ. Y. Lev. XXV, 3 sq. (h. text זמר); a. e.—B. Kam. 81 b גזרתינהו לשקך וכ' ed. (Ar. גַּזְרִית, Ms. R. גַּזְרִי, Ms. F. אַגְזַרְתִּינְהוּ Af.) I should have split thy shoulder with the iron weapon (i.e. should have excommunicated thee).—ג' קיימא to make a covenant (h. כָּרַת בְּרִית). Targ. Gen. XV, 18; a. fr.

Targ. Gen. XVII, 10; 11; a. fr.—Targ. Y. Lev. XIX, 23 ג' גזרא (h. text ערל ערלה, v. עָרְלָה).—Part. pass. גְּזִיר, pl. גְּזִירִין. Targ. Y. Gen. XVII, 13. Targ. Josh. V, 5; a. e.—Macc. 11 a (prov.) שכם נסיב ומבגאי גזיר (Gen. R. s. 80 ומגבאי קטע) Shechem wants to marry (Dinah), and Mabgai (his subject) must submit to circumcision. Gen. R. l. c. גְּזוֹר be thou circumcised. Y. Kidd. III, 64 d bot. מהו מִיגְזוֹר וכ' how about circumcising … on the Sabbath? Y. Sabb. XIX, 16 d bot. הוה ליה עובדא למיגזור וכ' had a case, when he was to have his son … circumcised (on a Sabbath). Y. Meg. I, 72 b bot. אזל וג' he (Antoninus) went and had himself circumcised; (Y. Snh. X, 29 c וגייר גרמיה); Koh. R. to IX, 10 הוה גזיר was circumcised; a. fr.

Targ. Job XXII, 28; a. e. Targ. Is. XXI, 17 גְזִיר כן it is so decreed.—Ab. Zar. 36 a ואתי אינהו וגָזוּר וכ' and they came and forbade (gentile bread &c.) even in the field. Sabb. 14 a גַּזְרֵי ביה … טומאה declared him unclean.—Ib. 53 b ולא גַזְרִינָן דילמא וכ' and we do not prohibit it (from fear) lest he may &c. Ab. Zar. 38 b גזרינן הא אטו הא we may forbid one thing in order to ward off from another thing; a. v. fr. V. גְּזֵרָה.
Targ. Job XVIII, 14; a. e.—Ms. מתגייר'; h. text יתמלל'. Targ. Ps. LVIII, 8 (Var. מתגורר').
Targ. Koh. VIII, 4; a. e.

(גזר) גְּזַר decree, גְּזַר דִּין sentence, legal decision, divine dispensation. Keth. 8 b אפי' נחתם לו ג' ד' של וכ' even if a divine decree granting seventy years of happiness were sealed to him; Sabb. 33 a. Lev. R. s. 26 בלי שטר ובלי ג' ד' without a note of indebtedness and without a judicial verdict. Ib. כמה גזר דין, corr. גִּזְרֵי דינין.—Y. Snh. III, 21 d top עבדון ליה ג' ד' the court passes sentence over him; a. fr.— Pl. גִּזְרֵי דינין, גִּיזְ'. Lev. R. l. c. Y. M. Kat. III, 82 a bot. (expl. גזירות ב"ד, Mish. III, 3) אילו גי' ד' that means judicial verdicts.

Y. Shebi. IX, 39 a top; Y. Shek. VI, end, 50 b מביא גי' אחד he may offer one log; (Bab. ed. Var. גזיר).— Pl. גְּזָרִין, גִּיזְרִין, גְּזִירִין. Tam. II, 3. Yoma II, 5 גְּזִירֵי עצים; Y. Shebi. l. c.; Y. Shek. l. c. גיזירי (corr. acc.); Bab. ed. גזרי. Tosef. Kel. B. Kam. I, 6 פצעין את מוחו בגזי' they split his scull with clubs; Snh. IX, 6 בגזי' Mish.; ib. 82 b בגיז'; Taan. 18 b בגיז'; (Sifra Emor Par. 8, ch. IX בבקעיות, v. בְּקַעַת); Koh. R. to III, 17 בגזי'; a. e.

verbetes.glosa_atual: , eu cap.; mesmo, peça; clube.; o que deve ser cortado (h. עָרְלָה).; (cmp. גְּזֵרָה) um guarda.
definicoes_originais: what is to be cut (h. עָרְלָה).
notas_originais: B. Kam. 81 b ג' דפרזלי (Ms. H. a. F. גְזִירֵי, R. גִיזְרֵי), v. גְּזַר.— Pl. גְּזִי', גִּזְרִין, גִּזְרֵי, גִּיזְ' (v. preced.). Targ. I Kings III, 25 לתרין ג' (ed. Lag. only לתרין) into two pieces (h. text לשנים).
Targ. Y. Lev. XIX, 23, v. גְּזר.
Sabb. 54 b דעבדו ליה לגי' (a strap on the foot of the ass) which is put on him as a guard (against knocking the feet against one another).

verbetes.glosa_atual: (cmp. h. גּוֹדְרוֹת) ovelhas em dobras, dobras, rebanho.
definicoes_originais: (cmp. h. גּוֹדְרוֹת) sheep in folds, fold, flock.
notas_originais: Targ. Prov. XXX, 31 בית גיז' Ms. (ed. גיורא) between the flock.— Pl. constr. גִּזְרֵי. Targ. I Kings XX, 27 (h. text חשיפי).

notas_originais: Targ. Am. V, 7. Targ. Prov. V, 4 גידדא ed. Lag. (ed. גיררא, גירא, corr. acc.; Ar. גִּידֵּי pl.).— Pl. גִּידִּין. Targ. Jer. IX, 14 Ar. (ed. גירין, corr. acc.). Ib. XXIII, 15; a. e.—(In h. diction) Yalk. Gen. 126, v. גַּד I. Tanḥ. B’shall., ed. Bub. 22 (play on גד) שהיה בפיהם כג' מרין the manna was in their (the gentiles’) mouths like bitter worm-wood. Sabb. 87 a (play on ויג̇ד̇, Ex. XIX, 9) דברים שקשין לאדם כגִֹידִֹּין words (of warning against punishment) which are as hard (distasteful) to man as worm-wood. [Targ. Y. I, II Gen. XLIX, 23 גידין, גידיא some ed., read גיר', v. גִּיר III.]
, v. preced.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (גדד) cheio de incisões, enrugado, [ou acre (?), v.
definicoes_originais: (גדד) full of incisions, wrinkled, [or acrid ( ?), v. גַּד I].
notas_originais: Y. Dem. II, beg. 22 b ג' הוא; v., however, גְּדוּרָא.
Erub. 93 b (Ms. M. גִּידּוּר, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 10); Gitt. 15 b ג' חמשה ומחיצה וכ' an earth embankment of five cubits and on it a partition wall of five.

verbetes.glosa_atual: . *Targ. É. XXXVIII, 12 נחל גי' ed. Atraso. (Rashi גְּדוּדָאִין) um wady entre aterros íngremes (Var. נְוַל גַּרְדָּאִין, h. texto אֹרֵג).—Sabb. 41 a לית ליה גי' (Sra. M. גד') não tem margens íngremes. Erub. 6 a דאיכא גי' onde há
notas_originais: . *Targ. Is. XXXVIII, 12 נחל גי' ed. Lag. (Rashi גְּדוּדָאִין) a wady between steep embankments (Var. נְוַל גַּרְדָּאִין, h. text אֹרֵג).—Sabb. 41 a לית ליה גי' (Ms. M. גד') has no steep banks. Erub. 6 a דאיכא גי' where there are yet embankments (remnants of ruined buildings).—בית ג' soil full of cuts, rough places. Targ. Is. XL, 4 (h. text רכסים).—Trnsf. snares. Targ. Ps. XXXI, 21 גידודי גיבריא (h. text רכסי) snares of mighty (violent) men (Ms. גברי גדודי).
, v. גְּדוּרָא

verbetes.glosa_atual: (גדל); criação dos filhos.; crescimento.; elevação à dignidade, elevação.
notas_originais: Snh. 19 b צער ג' בנים the trouble of rearing children; Gen. R. s. 20; Erub. 100 b

Ber. VI, 3 דבר שאין גִּדּוּלֹו וכ' (Y. ed. גִּידּוּלָיו pl.) whatever does not grow out of the soil (animal food &c.); a. fr.— Pl. גִּידּוּלִין, constr. גִּידּוּלֵי. Y. ib. V, 9 c top דרך גִּידּוּלֵיהֶן the way they grow, v. גְּדִילָה.—Ned. VII, 6 אסור בחלופיהן (ובגִידּ') וּבגִדּוּלֵיהֶן it is forbidden to eat or enjoy what has been exchanged for the fruits or what has grown of their seeds. Ib. גידולי ג' growths of the second degree. Y. Ter. VII, end, 45 a ג' איסור products of forbidden seeds. Ber. 40 b ג' קרקע products of the ground; a. fr.
— Pl. as above. Gen. R. s. 55 beg. ג' אחר ג' (Yalk. ib. 95 גְּדוּלָּה, Yalk. Ps. 777 גִּדָּלֹון).

Y. Meg. III, end 74 c ר' גי'; Yoma 69 b ר' גדל. Y. Bets. I, 60 a (without title). Kidd. 59 a ר' גידל; a. fr.—G. b. Binyamin, b. Minyamin (Minyomi). Y. Pes. VIII, end, 36 b.—Y. B. Bath. III, 14 a; Bab. ib. 39 b; a. fr.—G. b. R’ulai. Gitt. 34 a
, v. גַּרְזִימֵי
Targ. Is. XXI, 14 פוקו ג' למיא ed. Lag. (v. notes p. XXIX, 2
come forth, ye ravines, to receive the waters (ed. Buxt. a. oth. נַגְדִּין). [Our w. prob. a corrupt. of גִּידּוּדִין.]

verbetes.glosa_atual: (גדע); derrubada.; aquilo que cresce de um toco; cmp. גֶּזַע.
definicoes_originais: that which grows out of a stump; cmp. גֶּזַע.
notas_originais: Y. Ab. Zar. IV, 44 a (ref. to Deut. VII, 5).— Pl. גִּידּוּעִין, constr. גִּידּוּעֵי. Bab. ib. 45 b ג'ע"א the execution of the laws concerning the destruction of objects used for idolatry.
Ib. שגִּידּוּעוֹ אסור וכ' the fresh growth of which is forbidden while the root is permitted; 48 a
Gitt. 56 b; a. e.— Pl. גִּידּוּפִין, גִּדּ'. Y. Ter. I, 40 d תפלתו ג' his prayer is blasphemy. Ex. R. s. 41, beg.; a. e.

verbetes.glosa_atual: B. Kam. 38 a דגי' הוא pois (sua forma de consolar) é blasfêmia.— Pl. גִּידּוּפִין, גִּידּוּפַיָּא, גִּדּ'. Targ. Eu Sam. II, 3. Targ. Y. Eu Deut. XXXII, 3 (II גַּדִּיפִין, גָּדִי').—Cant. R. para I, 6 מדינתא דחירופיא וג' uma cidade cheia
notas_originais: B. Kam. 38 a דגי' הוא for (their way of consoling) is blasphemy.— Pl. גִּידּוּפִין, גִּידּוּפַיָּא, גִּדּ'. Targ. I Sam. II, 3. Targ. Y. I Deut. XXXII, 3 (II גַּדִּיפִין, גָּדִי').—Cant. R. to I, 6 מדינתא דחירופיא וג' a city full of scorn and blasphemy (Cæsarea).
—ג' ערוה chastity. Lev. R. s. 32; v. גֶּדֶר a. גְּדֵירָה.—Y. Dem. III, 23 c top מפני גידורו, read גְּדֵירוֹ, v. גָּדֵיר.—Erub. 93 b, v. גִּידּוּד.
pr. n. m., v. גִּידּוֹל
